items.html: And Yaakov is a chariot to the six externals, and Moshe to the internals — this one from within and this one from without, as is stated in the portion Balak and in the Tikkunim. And this is what we say: Moshe merited Bina, as is stated in the Ra'aya Mehemna, that he merited the internal extremities, which are from Bina, and its spreading until Hod, in the secret of the fifty gates of Bina. And this is the course of the Tree of Life of five hundred years.
